agreement: Agree means: in both Figma and code, the same value in every mode, the CSS name matches the Figma WEB code syntax, and tokens.css matches tokens.json. Descriptions are not part of agreement. A token whose override is no longer needed still agrees. The total is every token in Figma or in code.
